0.content: In the weapon story of Surf's Up, the Volcano Lord, bored in the dark volcano, decides to wash his possessions in the cleanest springs in Natlan, those of the People of the Springs, fouling them with smoke and filth. Cochanina visits him unarmed, tells him that the treasure of Uenuku lies under the sea, and challenges him to surf to it. As he flounders in her wake she throws a drifting pufferfish and cries that it is the key. He chases it, is stung, and tumbles off. The prize for the real First All-Tribe Surfing Championship, the Surf's Up catalyst, is held for safekeeping at the Leisurely Puffer by Mualani.

1.content: Several Pyro Archons, including Cochanina, Shulevitz, Gloharry and Isaja, are recorded as working to contain the Bakunawa in the Mare Jivari; a temple was built to hold it. Cochanina's note, found in the Last Survivor of Tenochtzitoc quest, calls it a multi-generation task, warns that her time is short, and entrusts her thoughts to the Sacred Flame. Isaja's note announces that the task is finished.
